# searchstax_api_key_association (Resource)





## Import

Import an existing API key association with `account_name/deployment_uid`.

```shell
terraform import searchstax_api_key_association.example account_name/deployment_uid
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_name` (String)
- `api_key` (String, Sensitive)
- `deployment_uid` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
